editorNote: Geopolitics set the tone today: fresh U.S. strikes on Iran and the retaliation that followed pulled both bitcoin and gold lower as traders priced in higher odds of a Fed rate hike this month. Single-stock stories cut the other way — a regulatory fight over Rocket Lab's Iridium buyout, a sharply more bullish Wall Street call on Duolingo, and a report that Google is readying a coding-focused Gemini model all point to company-specific catalysts still very much in play beneath the macro noise.

stories.headline: SpaceX asks FCC to scrutinize Iridium's conduct as Rocket Lab's $8B buyout heads to a vote
stories.summary: SpaceX filed a complaint urging the FCC to examine Iridium Communications' conduct as regulators review Rocket Lab's pending $8 billion acquisition of the satellite operator. Rocket Lab shares fell 6% to $63.82 on the news; Iridium shareholders are set to vote on the deal September 24.
stories.whyItMatters: Iridium's payout is partly a variable number of Rocket Lab shares priced near closing, so any regulatory delay from the FCC dispute directly weighs on RKLB stock ahead of the vote.

sourceLinks.title: Rocket Lab Falls 6% as SpaceX Flags Iridium Deal to the FCC

stories.headline: Google reportedly readies Gemini 3.8 Flash, a coding-focused model, for launch as soon as today
stories.summary: Google DeepMind is preparing to release Gemini 3.8 Flash, internally called "Skimaki," with upgraded agentic-coding capabilities aimed at narrowing the gap with OpenAI and Anthropic, according to a Wall Street Journal report. Alphabet shares rose 0.6% in after-hours trading Tuesday on the report.
stories.whyItMatters: Agentic coding has become one of AI's biggest enterprise use cases, an area where Google has trailed rivals; a more competitive coding model could shift enterprise demand toward Google Cloud.

sourceLinks.title: Google prepares Gemini 3.8 Flash to narrow AI coding gap, WSJ reports

stories.headline: Evercore more than doubles Duolingo price target to $210, upgrades to Outperform
stories.summary: Evercore ISI raised its rating on Duolingo to Outperform from In Line and lifted its price target to $210 from $105, citing survey data showing 53% of U.S. language learners use Duolingo versus 13% for Babbel, with user retention near an all-time high of 84%.
stories.whyItMatters: Evercore's revised estimates put Duolingo's 2027 and 2028 earnings per share 10% and 25% above Street consensus, even as the firm flags that revenue and bookings per daily active user are both declining year over year.

sourceLinks.title: Evercore upgrades Duolingo, sees strong user growth and earnings upside

stories.headline: Bitcoin falls below $77,000 as fresh US strikes on Iran rattle risk assets
stories.summary: Bitcoin opened down 1.5% at $77,395.89 and slid further to $76,597 by mid-morning, while ether fell 2% to $2,374, after a new round of U.S. airstrikes on Iranian targets prompted Iranian retaliation against American military bases.
stories.whyItMatters: Rising oil prices from the escalation are lifting the market-implied odds of a Fed rate hike this month, and higher-rate expectations are pressuring non-yielding assets like bitcoin.

sourceLinks.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Wednesday, September 2, 2026: crypto prices tumble as Iran war reignites

stories.headline: Gold slips to $4,357 even as the US-Iran conflict escalates
stories.summary: Gold futures opened at $4,377.20 an ounce, down 0.4%, and slipped further to $4,357.50 by late morning, despite a second round of U.S. airstrikes on Iran in three days and Iranian retaliation against U.S. bases.
stories.whyItMatters: Gold is trading more as a rates asset than a crisis hedge right now: rising oil prices from the conflict are boosting the odds of a Fed rate hike, which is outweighing the metal's usual safe-haven bid.

sourceLinks.title: Gold price today, Wednesday, September 2, 2026: Gold slips further as military actions escalate in Iran
